thread:
Sara L: Heads up — our nightly bulk embed job for Acme started failing around 02:04 UTC with a bunch of 429s and a couple of dimension errors. stacktrace attached below.

Raj P: Sorry to hear. Is this sustained 429s or bursts?

Sara L: Mostly bursts, ~30s windows where ~50% of requests return 429. Intermittent responses also include: "400 Bad Request: embedding dimension mismatch (expected 1536, got 1024)" — we deploy a client change last night but can't repro locally.

Emily G: Important: dimension errors point to the client sending vectors or an upstream embedder model change. 429s likely ratecap. Can you paste a sample request/response?

Sara L: Pasting a minimal failing request and response (redacted):

```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"open-embed-1536:v2","input":["...lots of texts..."], "batch_size":256}
```

Response snippets:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":{"type":"rate_limited","message":"rate limit exceeded","retry_after":1.8}}
```

and a dimension failure:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":{"type":"invalid_request","message":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024"}}
```

Matt R: Two separate problems that can amplify each other: 1) client sending very large batch_size / concurrency will hit rate caps. 2) dimension errors probably from a mixed fleet of embedder versions — some nodes still running old 1024-dim model.

Raj P: How many concurrent workers are you running for nightly job?

Sara L: 40 parallel workers, each sending batch_size=256. Total queued tokens ~3M.

Emily G: That concurrency + large batches explains the 429s. For dimension mismatch, can you confirm model name pinning? If client uses a model alias that recently changed underlying variant, clients may get different dims.

Sara L: We pinned to open-embed-1536:v2 in config. But our ingestion service loads a cached docker image. We did a rolling update yesterday.

Matt R: Action plan: 1) reduce concurrency and batch_size temporarily to recover (try workers=8, batch_size=64). 2) run a quick validation step that checks embedding dimension on a small sample before large job. 3) Eng-runtime to check if we had a model mix during rollout.

Hugo (ops-bot): Noted. I've dropped a ticket to eng-runtime (runtime-3212) to investigate model variants on the pool used by Acme's project.

Raj P: For immediate mitigation, Sara — please run the job with exponential backoff and jitter. Example pseudo: 
```
retry = 0
while retry < 6:
  try:
    call_embeddings()
  except RateLimitError as e:
    sleep_time = (2**retry) * 0.5 + random.uniform(0,0.5)
    time.sleep(sleep_time)
    retry += 1
```

Sara L: Will do. Any guidance on client-side dim check code?

Emily G: Add a quick sanity check after receiving embeddings: if len(embedding) != expected_dim -> log and drop batch before sending for downstream indexing. Prefer failing fast. Example: 
```
if len(vec) != 1536:
  log.error("dim mismatch", got=len(vec))
  raise ClientValidationError()
```

Matt R: Also check that your client isn't accidentally switching model names depending on environment variable. We saw one customer with a config fallback to a 1024-dim model when a prod flag was off.

Sara L: Quick question on quota — can we request a temporary burst lift for Acme's nightly window? They pay a committed volume but hitting cap.

Billing Bot: @Sara L — ticket created: BILL-8843. For burst increases we need timeframe and peak RPS. Please provide a 24h window and expected peak token/sec.

Sara L: I'll send numbers. Estimated peak was ~1200 requests/s during the spike, average 250 req/s.

Raj P: In parallel, Eng-runtime: please confirm whether rolling update coincided with job time (02:00-03:00 UTC). If model variant overlap happened, we need to invalidate warm caches and restart affected nodes.

Hugo (ops-bot): runtime-3212 updated: logs show a canary yesterday that failed to drain before the rollout — ~12 nodes still on old model for ~45 minutes. That overlaps the job start.

Matt R: That explains the dimension mismatch. Root cause: partial rollout + our cache/placement allowed mixed dims. Fix: block rolling upgrades during high-customer-batch windows (we should add a gating rule) and add an agent-side dim probe during warmup.

Emily G: Long-term: recommend clients pin exact model digest (not alias) and run preflight dim verification. Platform: add an API response header X-Embedding-Dim:1536 so clients can quickly confirm.

Sara L: For immediate recovery I'm going to: 1) pause the job, 2) lower concurrency and batch_size, 3) enable client-side dim check, 4) re-run small sample to confirm OK, 5) request temporary burst lift.

Raj P: Sounds good. Keep this thread updated when you re-run. If you still see 429s after lowering concurrency, we'll escalate to infra on-call to check per-account rate caps and upstream throttles.

Sara L: Re-ran with workers=6 batch_size=64 and small preflight. No dim errors, 429 reduced to <1% and backpressure handled by client. Will follow up with metrics and billing ticket details. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Matt R: Filing follow-ups: runtime-3212 (model rollout behavior) and infra-429-analytics (per-account throttle dashboard).

Hugo (ops-bot): runtime-3212 updated -> assigned to emily_g. infra-429-analytics created -> assigned to matt_r.

Sara L: Closing loop: Acme's job completed successfully after changes. Logging this so support runbook can include the checks we used.

Raj P: Great — please paste the minimal preflight script you used so we can add to support docs.

Sara L: Pasting preflight script here: 
```
# preflight: sample 5 texts, request embeddings, verify dims
samples=["a","b","c","d","e"]
resp = client.embeddings(model="open-embed-1536:v2", input=samples)
for e in resp.data:
  assert len(e.embedding) == 1536
print("preflight OK")
```

Raj P: Perfect. I'll add to support checklist. Closing thread once docs updated.

Sara L: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: matt_r to confirm rollout gating rule timeline.

Emily G: I'll draft the header proposal and the runtime fix.

Sara L: Done — thread closed in 24h unless new issues. :white_check_mark:
